name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: 0.0.214: Sound help. On a server that doesn't convert (set so, or too weak), a friend's title whose picture a device plays but whose sound or file type it doesn't (Dolby or DTS sound in a browser, a Matroska file) now plays instead of failing. When only the file type is wrong, this server repackages it, converting nothing. When the sound itself doesn't play, the picture is copied untouched and only the sound goes to your linked server, which turns it into AAC stereo and sends it back; the picture never leaves this server. Starting takes a few seconds longer; the loading bar says why and shows an estimate. Seeking starts a new stream at the new place. Nothing is saved. Needs a linked server on 0.0.214 that may convert. Not yet checked on physical TVs or phones.
